title: quercus ilex f. ballota
intro: Quercus ilex f. ballota, commonly known as Holm Oak or Ballota Oak, is a plant species within the Quercus ilex complex, characterized by its distinctive foliage and growth habit. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Quercus ilex f. ballota are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce stress, and promote relaxation, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety and sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine.
